subject: Fix memory leak in test_quicklist.c unit test (#1797)
reason: The change only adds a zfree() in the unit test file src/unit/test_quicklist.c to fix a memory leak in the test harness itself. No server source code, command behaviour, replication, persistence or tooling is touched, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or exercise the change; it is covered by running the unit test suite, not by runtime scenarios.
